long_biography.plain_text:
BESTSELLER began with a single Danish clothing store opened by Troels Holch Povlsen and Merete Bech Povlsen in 1975. Their son Anders joined the company as a teenager, managed the VILA brand and took over as owner and managing director at 28. Under his leadership, the inherited platform expanded its international store network, brand portfolio and digital retail operations. He remains its owner and chief executive.

Beyond BESTSELLER, Povlsen founded HEARTLAND as the family's investment holding company. Its portfolio spans fashion, online retail, payments, food delivery, renewable energy and other technology-led businesses, but BESTSELLER remains the core. Wildland is a separate land-stewardship enterprise centred on Scottish estates and a long-term programme of habitat restoration. These investments and conservation holdings broaden his activities without replacing fashion retail as his principal economic foundation.
